messages:
sam: Quick check — proposing the cut window Fri May 20 22:00 UTC for v2.1.
sam: I'd like to run a short go-decision / dry-run sync Thu May 19 16:00 UTC (30m). Can core stakeholders RSVP? Need: rollout owner, rollback owner, infra on-call, QA lead, security rep.

maria: I can own rollback plan + runbook review. :thumbsup:

leo: Thu 16:00 works for me, can we add a 10m dry-run of the deploy steps? Want to validate hooks and canary routing.

anika: I'm good to be on call for QA signoff; will bring the smoke test matrix.

priya: heads up — product review meeting overlaps for me 16:00-16:30. If we shift to 15:30 or 17:00 I can join.

sam: @priya noted. Preference check: 15:30 or 17:00? reply with ✅ for 15:30, 🔁 for 17:00.

maria: ✅ (prefers earlier)

leo: 🔁 (prefers later by 30m but can make either)

anika: ✅

priya: 🔁


deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window check: no infra maintenance conflict detected for Fri May 20 21:00-23:00 UTC. See <https://infra.redwood.example/maintenance/2027-05-20>.


sam: Ok looks like split. I'll send a poll for 15:30 vs 17:00 and tentatively book 15:30 for 30m. Agenda draft below — please add owners inline.

sam: ```Agenda (30m)
- 0-5m: quick rollout summary & cut confirmation (sam)
- 5-15m: dry-run of deploy steps + canary traffic (leo)
- 15-22m: QA smoke results & exit criteria (anika)
- 22-27m: rollback plan + runbook signoff (maria)
- 27-30m: final decision & next steps, obv. owners and on-call (sam)
```

sam: Add links: runbook: <https://runbooks.redwood.example/v2.1-deploy>, canary dashboard: <https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/canary>.


maria: Also add perf sigs to the agenda — we should validate tail latency and token throughput before cut. I'll bring the perf thresholds.


leo: I'll prepare a 5-step dry-run script and paste commands in the thread before EOD.


anika: QA will run the smoke suite on the staging canary after the dry-run; will post failures inline.


sam: Thanks all. I'll publish invite + poll in ~1h and update this thread with final time + calendar link. If anyone else should be added to the attendee matrix (legal/compliance/ops), @mention them here.

priya: Add security (deepa) and legal (ethan) pls.

sam: noted, adding deepa and ethan to invites.

sam: Final note — if we can't reach unanimous ✅ on the release decision, fallback is to delay cut by 24h and run a second dry-run.

sam: Sending poll now. :mailbox_with_mail:
